tileset.indexing: 0-based index = row * 3 + col. x = col * 32. y = row * 32.
notes: This index is based on the actual visual order of the provided spritesheet, not the earlier written list.
The first 9 tiles are arranged visually as a 3x3 block: outer top-left, top, outer top-right, left, center, right, outer bottom-left, bottom, outer bottom-right.
Tile 13 and tile 22 are intentionally empty/non-walkable cutout centers.
